evals.name: build-generator
evals.prompt: Set up generation for a backend using Cratis.Arc rather than the full Cratis package.
evals.expected_output: Build dependency and concrete output directory.

evals.name: find-author
evals.prompt: Generate the contract from Features/Authors/Listing/Author.cs under generated/Features/Authors/Listing/Author.ts and import AllAuthors.
evals.expected_output: Namespace and source grouping configured on the producer.
assertions: Enables CratisProxiesUseSourceFileAsOutputFile and sets matching host GeneratedApis routes in appsettings.json.
Imports AllAuthors from the generated Author module and compiles the consumer.

evals.name: shared-directory
evals.prompt: Two backends write different TypeScript contracts to one output directory. Is incremental generation enough protection?
evals.expected_output: Give each producer a dedicated output directory.
assertions: Explains orphan cleanup still occurs in incremental mode.
Does not share output between generating projects.
Fixes the producer configuration rather than patching generated files.
